summary: Master the art of web-based GIS and mapping with this in-depth training course. Enhance your skills, elevate your career, and drive organizational success.
lede: Web-based GIS and mapping connects spatial data, services and interactive maps for analysis through web applications. It is for GIS analysts, developers and other technical professionals moving beyond desktop workflows, with practice in managing spatial databases, publishing web services and building interactive maps using APIs and vector data.
audienceIntro: This program is designed for technical professionals who need to transition from desktop-centric GIS to scalable, web-enabled spatial architectures.
modules: Web GIS Architecture and OGC Standards
Frontend Development with Leaflet and OpenLayers
prerequisites: Participants should have a working knowledge of GIS concepts and basic familiarity with SQL or JavaScript. No prior web development experience is required, but an understanding of spatial data formats (Shapefiles, GeoPackage) is essential.
